name: SynapLogic sale proxy unbounded referral rebates
summary: The SYP sale implementation paid a per-entry referral rebate without bounding aggregate rebates by the payment received. A bounded pre-remediation campaign depleted the proxy's native ETH and USDC inventory through the affected native and USDC purchase paths.

loss.notes: Gross loss is exact victim-proxy depletion across the bounded 22-transaction campaign. The native anchor sends 13.82328425 ETH into the proxy and pays 41.46985275 ETH from it, depleting 27.6465685 ETH; archive balance falls from exactly 27.6465685 ETH to zero. Nineteen later incident receipts send 1,770.548698 USDC into the proxy and 5,311.097380 USDC from it, for 3,540.548682 USDC receipt-net depletion. Two linked precursor transfers from a campaign EOA supply another 90 USDC and are excluded from victim loss. Archive balances reconcile exactly: 3,450.548686 opening + 90 precursor + 1,770.548698 receipt inflows - 5,311.097380 outflows = 0.000004 ending, so victim inventory depletion is 3,450.548682 USDC. The transaction set includes every proxy USDC outflow from the first linked receipt through the last cleanup receipt before the first post-incident upgrade. USDC is valued at par; the closest preceding DefiLlama ETH observation is $3,189.1171414638065 at 1768866603, 12 seconds before the anchor. Exact component values total $91,618.69418800332, replacing the seed's rounded $144,000 estimate.

ageReset.description: The proxy was directly created with its EIP-1967 implementation slot selecting 0xc859ac8429fb4a5e24f24a7bed3fe3a8db4fb371. The slot and the selected 8,489-byte implementation runtime remain unchanged through the pre-incident state; all canonical proxy upgrades occur after the incident. Proxy deployment is therefore the latest age reset for the implicated implementation.

sources.note: Reviewed all 22 campaign transactions and receipts, the anchor call trace, archive native and USDC balances, the published technical analysis, commit-pinned reproduction, direct proxy creation receipt, EIP-1967 implementation history, implementation runtime, canonical upgrade logs, and the independently preceding ETH price. The anchor succeeds at Base block 41038634 index 82, timestamp 1768866615. Its trace reaches proxy 0x39f36e2e58f36f7e5c17784847fd07da1fee1a32 and delegates to 0xc859ac8429fb4a5e24f24a7bed3fe3a8db4fb371. The proxy receives 13.82328425 ETH and pays 30 rebates totaling 41.46985275 ETH, exactly depleting its 27.6465685-ETH opening archive balance. Starting 1,106 seconds later, a second EOA submits 15 USDC purchases through selector 0x7f7f92f5. A third campaign EOA supplies 50 and 40 USDC in two precursor transfers and submits two more purchases; the second EOA later submits two cleanup calls through helper 0x76ef87af8efb4cd967ee111850dcbf9ed6eb85ff. These 19 receipts comprise every proxy USDC outflow before the first post-incident upgrade. Receipt logs total 1,770.548698 USDC in and 5,311.097380 USDC out, or 3,540.548682 USDC receipt-net depletion. Excluding the linked 90-USDC precursor funding gives exact victim inventory loss of 3,450.548682 USDC. Archive balances reconcile from 3,450.548686 opening to 0.000004 ending. The same unchanged proxy implementation and referral-overdistribution behavior link the native and USDC sequences; the published analysis also identifies the second-EOA USDC sequence as the continuation of this incident. The final cleanup lands at block 41041337 index 206, timestamp 1768872021, before remediation. The proxy was directly created by 0xaf4d0fe93eeddabbd4ddb7451f09e6359575c214 in 0xa8356095...de6a at block 36732639 index 68, timestamp 1760254625. Proxy code is absent and the implementation slot is zero one block earlier; the creation state selects 0xc859ac8429fb4a5e24f24a7bed3fe3a8db4fb371, as does the pre-incident state. Its 8,489-byte runtime hashes to 0x7a71e2948a1a64f69d9a1518f8f94a40ccd8ac4726d05f07b4a8001a793d8ec0 at proxy creation and immediately before the incident. All six canonical Upgraded events occur at block 41047082 or later, after the campaign. Code age is 1768866615 - 1760254625 = 8,611,990 seconds. The closest preceding DefiLlama ETH point is $3,189.1171414638065 at 1768866603, 12 seconds before the anchor. It values the ETH loss at $88,168.14550600332; adding USDC at par gives $91,618.69418800332.
